pages.title: Webex Lab Free University
pages.lede: Seventy-eight self-contained rooms for Control Hub, Webex Calling, both contact-center products, Dedicated Instance, migrations, SIP, flows, workforce and quality, AI agents, and platform bridges. Read offline. Product claims stay cited.
pages.howTo: Start Here opens the sequence. Track tiles open a track. The room search is the list with id rooms.

pages.title: Start here
pages.lede: Read Control Hub before a dial plan, and the contact-center overview before a queue. The 30/60/90 sequence is a Canon study plan. It is not a Cisco learning path and it does not promise an exam result.
pages.howTo: Read the sequence on this page before you jump to a dial plan. The links are the order the lab recommends.

pages.title: Glossary
pages.lede: Every term collected from the written rooms. Open a term to land in the room that defines it. The citation links live in that room.
pages.howTo: Filter the terms. Open a term to land in the room that defines it. Definitions stay in the rooms.

pages.title: Animated flows
pages.lede: 39 call, signal, and data flows. Each one is a custom SVG with a moving packet. Architecture diagrams stay on the atlas. These are study drawings, not vendor limits.
pages.howTo: Each card is an animated SVG. Open the SVG file link under the drawing. The packet moves when motion is allowed.

pages.title: Diagram atlas
pages.lede: 60 custom SVGs. 60 use animateMotion. 39 are tagged as call, signal, or data flows. SMIL runs when the file is embedded as an object. Each card is a study drawing, not a vendor limit.
pages.howTo: Each card is a study drawing. The note on the drawing says to read the room before treating a hop as a product limit.

pages.title: Charts
pages.lede: Counts from this repository. No traffic, no revenue, and no invented adoption numbers.
pages.howTo: Charts on this page are study charts. Read the caption next to the chart before you quote a number.

pages.title: Cheat Codes
pages.lede: One-page sheets (26 topics), a 959-card deck harvested from the rooms, and a zip of this site. Nothing here is hosted on a vendor CDN. Each topic has HTML, SVG, PDF, and PNG in the repository. The PDF and PNG are renders of that HTML, not copies of a Cisco document.
pages.howTo: Cheat sheets are one HTML page each, with a PDF and a PNG beside them. Open a sheet, then the room it points at.

pages.title: Practice Quiz
pages.lede: 483 checks across the written rooms. Room pages keep their own quizzes. Reveals on a room still update that room’s progress. This bank is practice.
pages.howTo: This bank is practice beside the room quizzes. Reveals on a room still belong to that room.

pages.title: Flashcards
pages.lede: 842 flashcards from the written-room glossaries and the facts those rooms cite. Know and Again stay in localStorage on this machine. Nothing is uploaded.
pages.howTo: Know and Again stay in this browser. Nothing is uploaded. The card names the room it came from.

pages.title: Hands-on Labs
pages.lede: Five study models in this browser. They cite the sentence they imitate. They are not Unified CM, not a contact-center tenant, and not a calling-search-space trace from a live cluster.
pages.howTo: The labs are browser models. They cite the sentence they imitate. They are not a live cluster.

pages.title: Play lab
pages.lede: A port game, a flow map, a call-flow sandbox, a daily question, badges, and a card you can save. Scores stay in this browser.
pages.howTo: Play is practice in this browser. When a score is shown, it is for that model only.

pages.title: Interview Prep
pages.lede: Questions a Webex Calling, Webex Contact Center, or UCCE-to-WxCC conversation actually asks. Each answer cites a written room. Where Cisco has not published a node map, T6-R04 keeps the row marked. The room is written.
pages.howTo: Each prompt cites a written room. Answer from that room, then open it to check.

pages.title: Mastery map
pages.lede: Fundamentals through the hard edges. Every row has a place to read. Anything this lab will not pretend to know is marked unverified.
pages.howTo: Rows are a path through the lab. Anything the lab will not pretend to know is marked unverified.

pages.title: Troubleshooting Cases
pages.lede: Each scenario is a decision with a cited consequence. Pick a choice. The note stays on this page. Scores stay in this browser.
pages.howTo: Each case has a cited fix. Open the room named on the case before you change a design.

pages.title: Ecosystem Map
pages.lede: One curriculum mind map for all eleven tracks, then a cross-lab concept map. The concept map is orientation only. A peer cell is a label beside Webex. It is not feature parity, and it is not a design you can build from.
pages.howTo: The mind map is the eleven tracks. The concept map is orientation, not a product blueprint.

pages.title: Ecosystem atlas
pages.lede: Calling, Contact Center, Meetings, Devices, Control Hub, workforce management, recording, emergency calling, analytics, and AI agents. Diagrams are study drawings. They are not Cisco architecture posters.
pages.howTo: Drawings here are study drawings. They are not Cisco architecture blueprints.

pages.title: Ports and protocols
pages.lede: Taken from the Webex Calling port reference on 2026-10-15. The article's revision history shows the phone source range moving to 5060–5280 on September 07, 2026. IP subnets are intentionally not copied. They change, and the article says filtering by region can hurt the service.
pages.howTo: Port numbers on this page come from the rooms and the ports cheat sheet. Open the cited room before you write an ACL.

pages.title: Careers
pages.lede: Study paths through this Canon. Job titles here are study labels, not Cisco requisitions.
pages.howTo: This page is career context for the lab. It is not a job offer and not a Cisco certification claim.

pages.title: Countries and residency
pages.lede: Flags mark regions named in the Canon room. This page does not invent carriers, dial plans, or a PSTN country matrix.
pages.howTo: Residency notes on this page point back at the data-residency room. Confirm the country in that room.
